subject: general
question: Between 1991 and 2020, India’s export-import trends show:

options.text: Rising imports outpacing exports and widening the trade deficit

solution:
The correct answer is __**Rising imports outpacing exports and widening the trade deficit**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Between 1991 and 2020, India's import volumes grew significantly due to factors like industrial growth, increasing consumption, and liberalization policies.
 
• Exports during this period also increased, but not at a pace equivalent to imports, leading to a widening trade deficit.
 
• The trade deficit represents the excess of imports over exports and has been a characteristic of India's international trade during this time.
 
• Key reasons for the rising imports include dependence on crude oil, machinery, electronics, and gold, which are critical for economic growth but not produced sufficiently domestically.
 
• Economic reforms such as liberalization in 1991 played a major role in this trend, opening up markets and increasing global trade participation.
 
• India’s export composition has shifted toward services like IT and software, but merchandise exports lagged behind in comparison to imports.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Export Trends**

 
 
• Strong Growth: Total exports (goods & services) hit record highs, exceeding $824 billion in FY 2024-25, with services (IT, etc.) leading the surge.
 
• Key Sectors: Engineering goods, electronics, pharma, and agriculture are major contributors, with electronics showing rapid expansion.
 
• Top Markets: USA, UAE, China, and the Netherlands are key destinations.
 
• Recent Dip: October 2025 saw a decline due to US tariffs, impacting textiles, gems, and shrimp shipments. 
 
 
 
• **Import Trends**
 
 
• Dominant Imports: Petroleum & products, gold, and electronic goods are primary imports.
 
• Key Sources: China, UAE, Russia, and the US are major suppliers.
 
• Growing Electronics: Electronics imports are rising, mirroring domestic demand.
